186 BOOST_STATIC_CONSTEXPR bool prefetch = Prefetch;

193 //! This option specifies whether block data (value storage) is inlined
194 //! in each block (true) or allocated separately via the allocator (false).
195 //! Inline data can improve locality but increases block size.
196 //!
197 //!\tparam Enabled A boolean value.
198 BOOST_INTRUSIVE_OPTION_CONSTANT(store_data_in_block, bool, Enabled, store_data_in_block)
199
200 //! This option specifies if hardware prefetch instructions
201 //! are emitted during iteration and other traversal operations.
202 //! When enabled, prefetching can improve performance by reducing
203 //! cache misses. The default value is true.
204 //!
205 //!\tparam Enabled A boolean value. True to enable prefetching.
206 BOOST_INTRUSIVE_OPTION_CONSTANT(prefetch, bool, Enabled, prefetch)
207
208 //! Helper metafunction to combine options into a single type to be used
209 //! by \c boost::container::nest.
210 #if defined(BOOST_CONTAINER_DOXYGEN_INVOKED) || defined(BOOST_CONTAINER_VARIADIC_TEMPLATES)
211 template<class ...Options>
212 #else
213 template<class O1 = void, class O2 = void, class O3 = void, class O4 = void>
214 #endif
215 struct nest_options
216 {
217 /// @cond
218 typedef typename ::boost::intrusive::pack_options
219 < nest_null_opt,
220 #if !defined(BOOST_CONTAINER_VARIADIC_TEMPLATES)
221 O1, O2, O3, O4
222 #else
223 Options...
224 #endif
225 >::type packed_options;
226 typedef nest_opt<packed_options::store_data_in_block, packed_options::prefetch> implementation_defined;
227 /// @endcond
228 typedef implementation_defined type;
229 };

273 BOOST_CONTAINER_FORCEINLINE int unchecked_countr_zero(boost::uint64_t x)
274 {
275 #if defined(BOOST_MSVC) && (defined(_M_X64) || defined(_M_ARM64))
276 unsigned long r;
277 _BitScanForward64(&r, x);
278 return (int)r;
279 #elif defined(BOOST_GCC) || defined(BOOST_CLANG)
280 4750x return (int)__builtin_ctzll(x);
281 #else
282 BOOST_CONTAINER_NEST_ASSUME(x != 0);
283 return (int)boost::core::countr_zero(x);
284 #endif
285 }
286
287 BOOST_CONTAINER_FORCEINLINE int unchecked_countr_one(boost::uint64_t x)
288 {
289 1760x return unchecked_countr_zero(~x);
290 }
291
292 BOOST_CONTAINER_FORCEINLINE int unchecked_countl_zero(boost::uint64_t x)
293 {
294 #if defined(BOOST_MSVC) && (defined(_M_X64) || defined(_M_ARM64))
295 unsigned long r;
296 _BitScanReverse64(&r, x);
297 return (int)(63 - r);
298 #elif defined(BOOST_GCC) || defined(BOOST_CLANG)
299 40x return (int)__builtin_clzll(x);
300 #else
301 BOOST_CONTAINER_NEST_ASSUME(x != 0);
302 return (int)boost::core::countl_zero(x);
303 #endif
304 }

306 // nth_set_bit: returns the bit-position of the nth set bit (0-indexed) in mask.
307 // Precondition: popcount(mask) > n >= 0.
308 //
309 // Two implementations selected at compile time:
310 // 1. BMI2 pdep + countr_zero (BOOST_CONTAINER_NEST_HAS_PDEP)
311 // 2. Binary search using popcount (default fallback)
312 //
313 // The default fallback halves the 64-bit mask with popcount at each step
314 // (branching variant). Define BOOST_CONTAINER_NEST_NTH_BIT_BRANCHLESS to
315 // select a branchless arithmetic variant of the same algorithm.
316
317 #if defined(BOOST_CONTAINER_NEST_HAS_PDEP)
318
319 BOOST_CONTAINER_FORCEINLINE int nth_set_bit(boost::uint64_t mask, int n)
320 {
321 return unchecked_countr_zero(_pdep_u64(boost::uint64_t(1) << n, mask));
322 }
323
324 #elif defined(BOOST_CONTAINER_NEST_NTH_BIT_BRANCHLESS)
325
326 BOOST_CONTAINER_FORCEINLINE int nth_set_bit(boost::uint64_t mask, int n)
327 {
328 int pos = 0;
329 int c;
330
331 c = boost::core::popcount(boost::uint64_t(mask & boost::uint64_t(0x00000000FFFFFFFFu)));
332 { const int s = (n >= c); pos += s * 32; mask >>= unsigned(s * 32); n -= s * c; }
333
334 c = boost::core::popcount(boost::uint64_t(mask & boost::uint64_t(0x000000000000FFFFu)));
335 { const int s = (n >= c); pos += s * 16; mask >>= unsigned(s * 16); n -= s * c; }
336
337 c = boost::core::popcount(boost::uint64_t(mask & boost::uint64_t(0x00000000000000FFu)));
338 { const int s = (n >= c); pos += s * 8; mask >>= unsigned(s * 8); n -= s * c; }
339
340 c = boost::core::popcount(boost::uint64_t(mask & boost::uint64_t(0x000000000000000Fu)));
341 { const int s = (n >= c); pos += s * 4; mask >>= unsigned(s * 4); n -= s * c; }
342
343 c = boost::core::popcount(boost::uint64_t(mask & boost::uint64_t(0x0000000000000003u)));
344 { const int s = (n >= c); pos += s * 2; mask >>= unsigned(s * 2); n -= s * c; }
345
346 { const int s = (n > 0); pos += s; mask >>= unsigned(s); }
347
348 return pos + unchecked_countr_zero(mask);
349 }
350
351 #else
352
353 BOOST_CONTAINER_FORCEINLINE int nth_set_bit(boost::uint64_t mask, int n)
354 {
355 int pos = 0;
356 int c;
357
358 c = boost::core::popcount(boost::uint64_t(mask & boost::uint64_t(0x00000000FFFFFFFFu)));
359 if (n >= c) { pos += 32; mask >>= 32; n -= c; }
360
361 c = boost::core::popcount(boost::uint64_t(mask & boost::uint64_t(0x000000000000FFFFu)));
362 if (n >= c) { pos += 16; mask >>= 16; n -= c; }
363
364 c = boost::core::popcount(boost::uint64_t(mask & boost::uint64_t(0x00000000000000FFu)));
365 if (n >= c) { pos += 8; mask >>= 8; n -= c; }
366
367 c = boost::core::popcount(boost::uint64_t(mask & boost::uint64_t(0x000000000000000Fu)));
368 if (n >= c) { pos += 4; mask >>= 4; n -= c; }
369
370 c = boost::core::popcount(boost::uint64_t(mask & boost::uint64_t(0x0000000000000003u)));
371 if (n >= c) { pos += 2; mask >>= 2; n -= c; }
372
373 if (n > 0) { pos += 1; mask >>= 1; }
374
375 return pos + unchecked_countr_zero(mask);
376 }
377
378 #endif

395 8x if (!pred(*first))
396 4x break;
397 6x return first;

1203 ✗ { return pp[index / N] + (index % N); }

1205 ✗ reference operator*() const BOOST_NOEXCEPT
1206 ✗ { return *operator->(); }
1207

1266 12x buffer(std::size_t n_, Allocator al_)

1268 {

1273 12x ~buffer()

1276 12x for(; begin_idx != end_idx; ++begin_idx) {
1277 ✗ alloc_traits::destroy(al, data + begin_idx);

1281 12x }

1284 12x T* end() const BOOST_NOEXCEPT { return data + end_idx; }

1288 42x BOOST_ASSERT(data && end_idx != cap);

1290 42x ++end_idx;
1291 42x }

1298 42x }

1300 Allocator al;
1301 std::size_t begin_idx;
1302 std::size_t end_idx;
1303 std::size_t cap;
1304 T* data;
1305
1306 private:
1307 buffer(const buffer&);
1308 buffer& operator=(const buffer&);

3042 typename nest<T, Allocator, Options>::size_type
3043 1x erase(nest<T, Allocator, Options>& x, const T& value)
3044 {
3045 1x return erase_if(x, equal_to_value<T>(value));
